upload_portal.name: UKVCAS (UK Visa and Citizenship Application Services)
upload_portal.notes: Register on UKVCAS before your appointment. Upload documents 24–48 hours in advance. Original documents must also be brought to your appointment.
login_instructions: Use the same email as your UKVI online application
Log in and navigate to 'My Documents'
Upload each document as a separate PDF or JPEG file

appointment_portals.name: UKVCAS Service Points (UK appointments for non-UK applicants — via embassy)
appointment_portals.notes: Book after completing your UKVI online application and paying the fee.

appointment_portals.name: VFS Global (UK visas from select countries)
appointment_portals.notes: Used in countries where VFS Global operates as the UK visa application centre.

uk.tracking_instructions: Use the reference number from your application acknowledgement email to track your application on the UKVI website.
booking_steps: Complete and pay for your UKVI online application at gov.uk/apply-uk-visa
You will receive an application reference number (e.g. GWF0XXXXXXXX)
Go to ukvcas.co.uk or vfsglobal.co.uk (depending on your country)
Register or log in with your application reference number
Select your nearest service point / application centre
Choose an available appointment date and time
Confirm your appointment and download the booking confirmation
Add the appointment to your calendar
Upload your documents online before the appointment
Attend your appointment with original documents

upload_portal.name: Depends on embassy — TLScontact, VFS Global, or Embassy direct
upload_portal.notes: Document upload requirements vary by embassy. Some require physical documents only at the appointment. Check your specific embassy's instructions.
upload_portal.upload_timing: At appointment or online (varies by embassy)
login_instructions: Visit the portal for your destination country's embassy
Register with a valid email address
Create an application and enter your personal details
Upload documents as PDF or JPEG (max 2MB each)
Ensure all pages are legible and not cut off
Bank statements must be certified copies or originals

appointment_portals.name: VFS Global — France, Spain, Greece, Netherlands and others
appointment_portals.notes: Used by many Schengen embassies. Select your country of application and destination country.

appointment_portals.name: TLScontact — France, Germany, Belgium, Czech Republic, Poland
appointment_portals.notes: Used by French, German and several other Schengen embassies.

appointment_portals.name: BLS International — Portugal, Spain (some markets)
appointment_portals.notes: Used in some countries for Portugal and Spain visas.

schengen.tracking_instructions: Track your application using the reference number provided at your appointment. Check via the VFS Global or TLScontact tracking portal.
booking_steps: Complete the Schengen visa application form (PDF or online)
Gather all required documents
Go to the portal for your destination country's embassy (VFS Global, TLScontact, or BLS)
Register with a valid email address
Select your country of residence and destination country
Choose your nearest visa application centre
Pick an available appointment slot
Download and save your booking confirmation
Add the appointment to your calendar
Bring all original documents plus photocopies to your appointment
Pay the visa fee at the application centre (€80 + service fee)
